body:
Measurement helps us answer real questions: How long? How heavy? How much? How much time?

Bigger units hold many smaller units:
1 foot = 12 inches, 1 yard = 3 feet
1 meter = 100 centimeters, 1 kilometer = 1,000 meters
1 kilogram = 1,000 grams, 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters
1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds

For rectangles:
Perimeter is the distance around: add all four sides.
Area is the space inside: length × width, in square units.

We will also measure bean sprouts to the nearest eighth of an inch and show our data on a line plot.
title: Measure, Convert and Plot
